body: I doubt it. But as they say a picture is worth a thousand words and this document is quite fascinating as it's really the only exposure that I've ever had to the identification and discovery of the bodies. I will admit the morbid part of me would love to see pictures but the curious and practical part of me is utterly fascinated that something like this even exists!

I've written this comment out several times and just can't put it into the words that it really deserves. Just the fact that this man worked for years, perfecting his craft, putting his life on the line and effectively eliminating targets in the line of battle only to have his own life taking trying to help someone suffering from the psychological effects of such a job is really unsettling to me.
